target_release: resolved from the published release pin
setup: copy shipping_server.py from the first-test guide into the project root

assertions: the tool result is not an error
the captured trace has one successful shipping_quote call with weight_kg 2 and zone local

compatibility.status: requires live verification and provider access

assertions: the judge result for answer.correctness.v1 has status PASSED

compatibility.model: YOUR_JUDGE_MODEL is replaced with a model the endpoint serves
compatibility.status: requires live verification and provider access

assertions: LLMJudge defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1 with a 30 second timeout and a 0.8 threshold
judge_response registers the judge under the evaluator name without register_evaluator
the judge sends the input, expected, and actual strings to the configured /chat/completions endpoint

compatibility.provider_credentials_required: only for the agent-evidence and llm-judge-live scenarios

network: The deterministic scenarios use a local stdio server and a loopback HTTP server. The live scenarios need provider access.
credentials: The deterministic scenarios need none. The judge scenario reads M3_JUDGE_API_KEY.
cleanup: MCPTestKit closes the client and server subprocess; the loopback test shuts down its HTTP server.
